name: curator-for-spotify

scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @curator/server" "npm run dev -w @curator/web"
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p packages/shared && tsc -p apps/server && tsc -p apps/web

description: Local web app + AI agent workflow to analyse your Spotify library, propose playlists, prune unused ones and build DJ sets.
